\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 220-223 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R228-first-pass-words-from-chapters-220-223}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a result and an explanation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item punctual, rainy, raw, salty, sour
  \item slim, dreadful, shy, independent, sunny
  \item thrifty, sporty, strict, likeable, dead
  \item faithful, typical, impatient, unhappy, married
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Punctual? (\textbf{pünktlich}.) Rainy? (\textbf{regnerisch}.) Raw? (\textbf{roh}.) Salty? (\textbf{salzig}.) Sour? (\textbf{sauer}.) Slim? (\textbf{schlank}.) Dreadful? (\textbf{schrecklich}.) Shy? (\textbf{schüchtern}.) Independent? (\textbf{selbstständig}.) Sunny? (\textbf{sonnig}.) Thrifty? (\textbf{sparsam}.) Sporty? (\textbf{sportlich}.) Strict? (\textbf{streng}.) Likeable? (\textbf{sympathisch}.) Dead? (\textbf{tot}.) Faithful? (\textbf{treu}.) Typical? (\textbf{typisch}.) Impatient? (\textbf{ungeduldig}.) Unhappy? (\textbf{unglücklich}.) Married? (\textbf{verheiratet}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 224-228 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R228-second-pass-words-from-chapters-224-228}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for in love and different.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item in love, different, careful, windy, funny
  \item an adventure, an idea, everyday life, training, an exhibition
  \item pronunciation, a meaning, a greeting, a description, a visit
  \item an application, a relationship, an impression, admission, an admission ticket
  \item a decision, a memory, permission, a result, an explanation
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
In love? (\textbf{verliebt}.) Different? (\textbf{verschieden}.) Careful? (\textbf{vorsichtig}.) Windy? (\textbf{windig}.) Funny? (\textbf{witzig}.) An adventure? (\textbf{das Abenteuer}.) An idea? (\textbf{die Ahnung}.) Everyday life? (\textbf{der Alltag}.) Training? (\textbf{die Ausbildung}.) An exhibition? (\textbf{die Ausstellung}.) Pronunciation? (\textbf{die Aussprache}.) A meaning? (\textbf{die Bedeutung}.) A greeting? (\textbf{die Begrüßung}.) A description? (\textbf{die Beschreibung}.) A visit? (\textbf{der Besuch}.) An application? (\textbf{die Bewerbung}.) A relationship? (\textbf{die Beziehung}.) An impression? (\textbf{der Eindruck}.) Admission? (\textbf{der Eintritt}.) An admission ticket? (\textbf{die Eintrittskarte}.) A decision? (\textbf{die Entscheidung}.) A memory? (\textbf{die Erinnerung}.) Permission? (\textbf{die Erlaubnis}.) A result? (\textbf{das Ergebnis}.) An explanation? (\textbf{die Erklärung}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
